name: Radio
summary: Single-select group built on Radix RadioGroup. .lumen-radio shell; inner dot composed via CSS ::after on data-state=checked. Items render as RadioGroupItem inside a RadioGroup. Grid layout with gap-3 by default.

rules: Visible focus ring required (outline + box-shadow per AGENTS.md hard rule 11).
Color is never the only signal — pair with label, shape, or icon.

dont: NEVER use Radio for 2 options — use Switch or Segmented.
NEVER use Radio outside a RadioGroup — single Radio doesn't make sense.
NEVER mix Radio styles within a single group.
